correctness.rationale: A 9-edge induced matching selects nine duads and nine synthemes; each chosen duad meets two unchosen synthemes, giving 2r<=3(15-r) and r<=9. At equality the six unchosen synthemes are six perfect matchings of the nine selected duads. The proved six-vertex nine-edge extremal lemma forces K_{3,3}, and hence exactly ten unordered 3+3 partitions and ten forced flag matchings; crossing-partition counting gives two maxima per flag and intersection exactly one. Binary weight-nine code distance is 2(9-1)=16; minimal simultaneous exchange changes eight edges. This is a proof for the one finite Tutte–Coxeter graph, not a general cubic-graph theorem.
